guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以「用真空、氣相通量與反彈證據判讀非飽和土壤氣相抽除」為主軸，依序處理污染概念模型與非飽和帶、含水率與氣相連通、質量移除與稀釋判別、尾氣處理介質突破、觀測網與證據缺口。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on Interpret unsaturated-zone vapor extraction through vacuum, gas mass flux and rebound, progressing through Conceptual site model and vadose zone, Moisture and gas connectivity, Mass removal versus dilution, Off-gas media breakthrough, Monitoring network and evidence gaps. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

evidence: 針對「污染概念模型與非飽和帶」，量土壤含水、各深度真空與氣體濃度，尋找被飽和水或低滲透層隔離區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「分層試抽與氣量配置」，同步記錄流量及分析濃度，積分質量率並核對處理單元前後負荷。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「含水率與氣相連通」，量土壤含水、各深度真空與氣體濃度，尋找被飽和水或低滲透層隔離區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「真空抽風機與能耗」，量測風量、差壓與輸入功率，在同一運轉點核對效率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「質量移除與稀釋判別」，同步記錄流量及分析濃度，積分質量率並核對處理單元前後負荷。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「脫附控制與長期拖尾」，用批次與柱試驗檢查 Kd 和濃度依賴性，將吸附物與溶解物總量守恆。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「尾氣處理介質突破」，做突破曲線並記錄流量、濃度與介質狀態，將可用容量與總化學容量分開。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「停抽與重啟反彈」，保留停機時間與多次重啟趨勢，對照水位、流量和空白樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「觀測網與證據缺口」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「階段交接與停止條件」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
evidenceEn: For Conceptual site model and vadose zone, Measure moisture, vacuum and gas concentrations by depth to locate zones isolated by water or low-permeability strata. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation, Record flow and concentration simultaneously, integrate mass rate and reconcile loads across off-gas treatment. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Moisture and gas connectivity, Measure moisture, vacuum and gas concentrations by depth to locate zones isolated by water or low-permeability strata. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Vacuum blower and energy demand, Measure airflow, differential pressure and input power at the same operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Mass removal versus dilution, Record flow and concentration simultaneously, integrate mass rate and reconcile loads across off-gas treatment. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Desorption control and tailing, Check Kd and concentration dependence in batch and column tests and balance sorbed plus dissolved mass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Off-gas media breakthrough, Measure breakthrough with flow, concentration and media condition; distinguish usable from total chemical capacity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Shutdown and restart rebound, Retain shutdown duration and repeated restart trends, comparing heads, flows and blanks. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Monitoring network and evidence gaps, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Phase handoff and stopping evidence, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
pitfalls: 水分上升可能令可抽氣孔隙變小卻加劇旁通。 在「污染概念模型與非飽和帶」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只以出口濃度降低判斷進度，可能把吸入清潔空氣視為整治。 在「分層試抽與氣量配置」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
水分上升可能令可抽氣孔隙變小卻加劇旁通。 在「含水率與氣相連通」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
堵塞使壓降上升，若只提高風機轉速可能增加能耗而不解決配流。 在「真空抽風機與能耗」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只以出口濃度降低判斷進度，可能把吸入清潔空氣視為整治。 在「質量移除與稀釋判別」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
把高遲滯因子解讀為已除污會漏掉未來脫附。 在「脫附控制與長期拖尾」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只用理論反應容量會高估介質壽命。 在「尾氣處理介質突破」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只報運轉中的低濃度會掩蓋未移除的污染庫存。 在「停抽與重啟反彈」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「觀測網與證據缺口」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「階段交接與停止條件」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
pitfallsEn: Rising moisture can reduce gas-filled pore volume while increasing bypass. Mark where this error can enter the Conceptual site model and vadose zone flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Concentration decline alone may mistake clean-air intrusion for remediation. Mark where this error can enter the Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Rising moisture can reduce gas-filled pore volume while increasing bypass. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and gas connectivity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Blockage raises pressure drop; speed increases may waste energy without correcting distribution. Mark where this error can enter the Vacuum blower and energy demand flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Concentration decline alone may mistake clean-air intrusion for remediation. Mark where this error can enter the Mass removal versus dilution flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Interpreting high retardation as cleanup overlooks later desorption. Mark where this error can enter the Desorption control and tailing flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Using theoretical reaction capacity alone overestimates media life. Mark where this error can enter the Off-gas media breakthrough flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Reporting low on-treatment values alone hides residual contaminant inventory. Mark where this error can enter the Shutdown and restart rebound flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Monitoring network and evidence gaps flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Phase handoff and stopping evidence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

courses.summary: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。
courses.summaryEn: The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.
